preact
======

Package:  preact
Version:  10.19.3
License:  MIT (see ./LICENSE)
Author:   Jason Miller <https://github.com/preactjs/preact>
Source:   https://esm.sh/preact@10.19.3/es2022/preact.mjs
Vendored: 2026-07-27

WHY VENDORED
------------
It was the last runtime CDN dependency. app/state.js used to import it from
esm.sh, which broke three things at once:

  - OFFLINE. sw.js passes cross-origin requests straight through and never
    caches them, so the service worker could hold the whole app and all its
    media and the instrument still would not boot without a live connection.
  - COEP. The page is Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp. esm.sh sends
    no Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header, so Safari refused the source maps
    and logged an access-control error on every load.
  - PRIVACY/AVAILABILITY. A third party saw a request from every visitor, and
    their outage would have been ours.

EXPORTS USED
------------
  h, render      (app/state.js; html = htm.bind(h))

Nothing else in the tree imports preact directly. app/starcruise.js is
deliberately kept off this module graph for its own reasons (Three.js must stay
off the boot path) — see the header comment there.

ONE MODIFICATION — the trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=preact.mjs.map` line was
removed. It is a relative name, but the browser resolves it against the module's
own url, and with the file served from here devtools went looking for a map we
do not ship; while the module still came from esm.sh it resolved there and the
map itself tripped the same CORP block described above. We do not ship .map
files (LOFO), so the reference had nothing to point at either way.

Otherwise the esm.sh es2022 build byte-for-byte. Self-contained: it imports
nothing, so there is no second-hop fetch to vendor.
